content.title: Adds Actions, form actions and new hooks, but removes long-deprecated APIs such as `propTypes` and `ReactDOM.render`.

keyPoints.text: `startTransition` now accepts async functions, so Actions can run side effects such as `fetch()` inside a Transition.
keyPoints.quote: Actions: `startTransition` can now accept async functions.

keyPoints.text: `useActionState` is a new hook for ordering Actions and reading their state, and `useOptimistic` shows optimistic state during a Transition.
keyPoints.quote: `useActionState`: is a new hook to order Actions inside of a Transition

keyPoints.text: `<form> action` manages forms automatically and integrates with the new `useFormStatus` hook.
keyPoints.quote: `<form> action` prop: Form Actions allow you to manage forms automatically and integrate with `useFormStatus`.

keyPoints.text: Refs can be passed as props, so `forwardRef` is no longer needed.
keyPoints.quote: `ref` as a prop: Refs can now be used as props, removing the need for `forwardRef`.

keyPoints.text: `react-test-renderer` now logs a deprecation warning and uses concurrent rendering for web usage.
keyPoints.quote: In React 19, react-test-renderer logs a deprecation warning and has switched to concurrent rendering for web usage.

breakingChanges.migration: Migrate to TypeScript or another type-checking solution.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `propTypes`: Using `propTypes` will now be silently ignored.

breakingChanges.change: Errors not caught by an Error Boundary are reported to `window.reportError` instead of being re-thrown.
breakingChanges.migration: Use `onUncaughtError` and `onCaughtError` on `createRoot` and `hydrateRoot` to customize error handling.
breakingChanges.quote: Errors in render are not re-thrown: Errors that are not caught by an Error Boundary are now reported to window.reportError.

breakingChanges.change: The new JSX transform is required.
breakingChanges.migration: Configure your compiler or bundler to use the new JSX transform.
breakingChanges.quote: New JSX Transform is now required

breakingChanges.migration: Migrate string refs to ref callbacks.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: string refs: Any usage of string refs need to be migrated to ref callbacks.

breakingChanges.change: Legacy Context for class components (`contextTypes` and `getChildContext`) is removed.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `contextTypes` and `getChildContext`: Legacy Context for class components has been removed

breakingChanges.change: `defaultProps` is no longer supported for function components.
breakingChanges.migration: Use ES6 default parameters instead. Class components still support `defaultProps`.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `defaultProps` for functions: ES6 default parameters can be used in place.
Removed: `React.createFactory`: Now that JSX is broadly supported, all `createFactory` usage can be migrated to JSX components.

breakingChanges.change: `react-dom/test-utils` is removed, and `act` has moved to `react`.
breakingChanges.migration: Import `act` from `react` and check your tests for other removed utilities.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `react-dom/test-utils`: We’ve moved `act` from `react-dom/test-utils` to react.
Removed: `ReactDOM`.`findDOMNode`: You can replace `ReactDOM`.`findDOMNode` with DOM Refs.

breakingChanges.migration: Use `react-shallow-renderer` directly, or move your tests to @testing-library/react.
breakingChanges.quote: Removed: `react-test-renderer/shallow`: This has been a re-export of

keyPoints.quote: Added resume APIs for partial pre-rendering with Web Streams:

keyPoints.text: React DOM now batches Suspense boundary reveals, matching client side rendering.
keyPoints.quote: React DOM now batches suspense boundary reveals, matching the behavior of client side rendering.

content.title: ESLint 10.11.0 brings new reports and fixes in `object-shorthand` and `no-unsafe-finally`; no breaking changes listed.

keyPoints.text: `no-unsafe-finally` now reports unsafe labeled `continue` statements.
keyPoints.quote: feat: report unsafe labeled `continue` in `no-unsafe-finally` rule (#21316) (electrohyun)

keyPoints.text: `new-cap` only exempts built-ins that reference the global.
keyPoints.quote: feat: only exempt `new-cap` built-ins that reference the global (#21290) (sethamus)

keyPoints.text: `object-shorthand` now handles quoted properties for `ignoreConstructors`.
keyPoints.quote: feat: object-shorthand handle quoted properties for `ignoreConstructors` (#21271) (Pavel)

keyPoints.text: `object-shorthand` no longer reports `__proto__` properties.
keyPoints.quote: fix: don't report `__proto__` properties in `object-shorthand` (#21310) (xbinaryx)

keyPoints.text: `prefer-object-spread` now ignores `__proto__` properties.
keyPoints.quote: fix: ignore `__proto__` properties in `prefer-object-spread` (#21311) (xbinaryx)

keyPoints.quote: fix: no-loss-of-precision false positive with trailing decimal point (#21251)

keyPoints.text: The docs now describe deprecation steps for end-of-life package versions.
keyPoints.quote: docs: add deprecation steps for EOL package versions (#21248)

keyPoints.text: Ecosystem plugins are updated to newer versions.
keyPoints.quote: chore: update ecosystem plugins (#21249)

content.title: Adds new scrollbar, zoom and tab utilities and @variant stacking, with several plugin and canonicalization fixes.

keyPoints.text: Adds a `@container-size` utility.
keyPoints.quote: Add `@container-size` utility

keyPoints.text: Adds `zoom-*` utilities for zooming elements.
keyPoints.quote: Add `zoom-*` utilities

keyPoints.text: `@variant` now accepts stacked variants such as `hover:focus`.
keyPoints.quote: Allow using `@variant` with stacked variants (e.g. `@variant hover:focus { … }`)

keyPoints.text: Fixes relative `@import` and `@plugin` paths resolving from the wrong directory with `@tailwindcss/vite`.
keyPoints.quote: Fix relative `@import` and `@plugin` paths resolving from the wrong directory when using `@tailwindcss/vite`

keyPoints.text: Canonicalization now migrates arbitrary `:has()` variants to the `has-[…]` form.
keyPoints.quote: Canonicalization: migrate arbitrary `:has()` variants from `[&:has(…)]` to `has-[…]`

content.title: Patch 4.2.4 fixes `@import` and `@plugin` resolution with Vite aliases in `@tailwindcss/vite`; no breaking changes.

keyPoints.text: Fixes resolution of `@import` and `@plugin` paths that use Vite aliases in `@tailwindcss/vite`.
keyPoints.quote: Ensure imports in `@import` and `@plugin` still resolve correctly when using Vite aliases in `@tailwindcss/vite`

keyPoints.text: The notes list no other changes, so this is a narrow fix-only release.
Projects that do not use Vite aliases with `@tailwindcss/vite` have no listed change to act on.

content.title: Zod 4.6 adds fast .validate(), z.iban() and z.withParser(), but changes emoji, enum options and JSON Schema output.

keyPoints.text: Adds `.validate()`, a boolean check that skips building a ZodError and can be up to 35x faster on compiled schemas.
keyPoints.quote: without constructing a `ZodError`, which makes rejection cheap

keyPoints.text: Adds `z.withParser()` to install a parser generated at build time, for environments that block `new Function`.
keyPoints.quote: installs a parser generated elsewhere, for environments without `new Function`

keyPoints.text: Adds `z.iban()`, which checks the electronic IBAN format and its mod-97 checksum.
keyPoints.quote: an IBAN in electronic format, with a valid ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 checksum

keyPoints.text: `fromJSONSchema()` now enforces six validation keywords it used to ignore.
keyPoints.quote: Six additional JSON Schema keywords are now supported in `z.fromJSONSchema()`.

keyPoints.text: Recursive schemas no longer retain the parsed input after a parse, which fixes a 4.5 out-of-memory regression.
keyPoints.quote: releases the parsed input, fixing a 4.5 out-of-memory regression

breakingChanges.change: Error maps now run when `result.error` is first read, not at parse time, so swapping `z.config()` between the parse and the read changes the messages.
breakingChanges.migration: Read `result.error` before changing `z.config()`, and do not rely on error map side effects that only happen at parse time.
breakingChanges.quote: Because `safeParse()` now builds its error lazily, error maps — global, locale, and per-schema `error` — run when `result.error` is first read, not at parse time.

breakingChanges.change: `z.emoji()` now rejects strings made only of emoji components, such as "123", "#" or a lone zero-width joiner.
breakingChanges.migration: Check any code that relied on `z.emoji()` accepting component-only strings, and handle those inputs explicitly.

breakingChanges.change: Numeric enum `.options` no longer include the reverse mapping keys, so it lists only the member values.
breakingChanges.migration: Check code that reads `.options` from a numeric enum and expected the old list with the reverse mapping keys.
breakingChanges.quote: Numeric enum options no longer include the reverse mappings

breakingChanges.change: The email pattern changed, so `z.regexes.email` has no capture groups, `issue.pattern` on a failed `z.email()` differs, and the emitted JSON Schema `pattern` has no lookahead.
breakingChanges.migration: Check code that reads capture groups from `z.regexes.email`, matches on `issue.pattern`, or consumes the `pattern` from `z.toJSONSchema()`.
breakingChanges.quote: The pattern string is user-visible, and every copy of it changes

keyPoints.text: `instanceof` now keys the `.properties()` shape off the instance type.
keyPoints.quote: feat(instanceof): key the .properties() shape off the instance type (#6600)

keyPoints.text: `z.currencyCode()` was added, reverted, then restored, so it is included in this release.
keyPoints.quote: Revert "Revert "feat: add z.currencyCode() over a vendored ISO 4217 list, refreshed weekly by CI (#6595)"

keyPoints.text: The properties docs now lead with the check and add a Zod Mini tab.
keyPoints.quote: docs: lead the properties section with the check and add a Zod Mini tab (#6598)

keyPoints.text: The integration peers were re-pinned to the workspace `zod` after the 4.6.5 bump.
keyPoints.quote: chore: re-pin the integration peers to the workspace zod after the 4.6.5 bump

content.title: Adds `@prisma/prisma7` so Prisma 7 can run beside Prisma 8, and secures Prisma Studio's local server.

keyPoints.text: A new `@prisma/prisma7` package lets Prisma 7 CLI and configuration run alongside Prisma 8 in one project.
keyPoints.quote: This release introduces `@prisma/prisma7`, a compatibility package

keyPoints.text: Prisma Studio's local server now binds to 127.0.0.1, rejects foreign origins and drops wildcard CORS headers.
keyPoints.quote: This prevents network clients or malicious websites from accessing Studio's database endpoints while Studio is running.

keyPoints.text: `P2002` errors from nested writes now report the correct model in `meta.modelName`.
keyPoints.quote: Fixed `P2002` errors from nested writes so `meta.modelName` identifies the model where the unique constraint violation occurred

keyPoints.text: Parameter-chunked statements now run atomically and roll back if a later chunk fails.
keyPoints.quote: Parameter-chunked statements are now executed atomically in a transaction and rolled back if a later chunk fails.

keyPoints.text: PostgreSQL deadlocks are now reported as `P2034` transaction write conflicts.
keyPoints.quote: PostgreSQL deadlocks using SQLSTATE `40P01` are now reported as `P2034` transaction write conflicts.
